name: Ample Classes Are Partial Cubes
scope: Finite ample set families and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: The one-inclusion graph of every finite ample class is a partial cube.
proof: One equivalent form of ampleness states that every strong projection has an isometric one-inclusion graph. Applying this to the class itself shows that graph distance equals Hamming distance on every pair of its members, so its one-inclusion graph embeds isometrically in the ambient hypercube.
